notes:
First attempt succeeded (no retries needed). Verdict is PASS: the declared 200 shape is {success, message, async} and the actual response matched exactly ({"success":true,"message":"test-runs linked successfully","async":false}), with no extra or missing keys. The flat (unwrapped) body shape the contract declares is also correct as written — sending issue_id/project_id/entity_type/entity_ids at the top level worked on the first try, so no nesting drift was found here (unlike the risk called out in the task).

CRITICAL CAVEAT on issue_id: no real Jira ticket key exists anywhere in this account (confirmed by two sibling probes: linked_test_cases_selection_v1 returns an empty selection for any issue_id, and every fixture case has issues:[]). Per the task's explicit allowance, I used the capability contract's own example value 'TES-121' (from its own body-field description) rather than inventing anything, and I am flagging that choice here as instructed. Because the handler is documented to never validate issue_id against the tracker ("A typo produces a link to a ticket that does not exist, with a 200 and a success message"), this call cannot by itself prove a live Jira integration exists on this account — it only proves the storage/response contract behaves as declared. Treat 'TES-121' as a provisional/unverified ticket key, not a confirmed real one.

Did I manage to create a real link? YES, in the sense that matters for the two follow-up probes: I verified via get_test_run_cases_v1 (project_id=379335744, test_run_id=TR-9061) that the run now carries a persisted issues[] entry: {id:848917, issue_id:'TES-121', jira_id:'TES-121', issue_type:'jira', entity_type:'Build', entity_id:17574995, record_status:'active'}. So a genuine row now exists in TM's link store referencing test run TR-9061 (uuid 17574995) — this satisfies the prerequisite for unlink_test_run_v1 (call it against TR-9061 / uuid 17574995, issue_id 'TES-121', project_id '379335744' or 379335744 as that capability's contract dictates). No test-case link was created (unlink_test_case_v1's prerequisite is NOT satisfied) — if that probe needs one, it will need its own case+selection setup, since I only exercised the test-run path here to avoid the undocumented selection-object shape.
